title: Watch Ya Mouth
style: Mandopop-pop with a bright four-on-the-floor pulse, snapped handclaps, plucky synth hooks, and a bouncing bassline; verse stays cheeky and conversational, pre-chorus strips to kick, bass, and vocal stabs, chorus opens with stacked doubles and a chantable lift. Lead vocal is close-mic and playful with crisp harmonies, tossed ad-libs, and short delay throws on key phrases. Ear candy includes reverse swells into the chorus, glassy bell accents between lines, and a final lift with wider backing vocals. Mix is glossy, punchy, and radio-bright., pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Don’t say “calm down,” mate
That’ll light the fuse
Don’t call me “too much”
When I’m minding my blues
Don’t roll your eyes, yeah
That’s a dumb move

Keep your gob shut
If you’ve got no clue

[Pre-Chorus]
Nah, don’t say that
Nah, not like that
One bad line and
We’re right off track

[Chorus]
Watch ya mouth, mate
Watch ya mouth
That’s the line
That brings it down
Watch ya mouth, mate
Watch ya mouth
Say it wrong
And I’m gone now
(Watch ya mouth)
(Watch ya mouth)

[Verse 2]
Don’t say “it’s fine” if
It’s clearly not
Don’t make a joke when
My heart’s gone hot
Don’t bring up old stuff
Then act all shocked

I’m not your punchline
I’m not your prop

[Pre-Chorus]
Nah, don’t say that
Nah, not like that
One loose word and
It all goes black

[Chorus]
Watch ya mouth, mate
Watch ya mouth
That’s the line
That brings it down
Watch ya mouth, mate
Watch ya mouth
Say it wrong
And I’m gone now
(Watch ya mouth)
(Watch ya mouth)

[Bridge]
Better watch that tone
Better choose your words
Ain’t every thought
Meant to be heard
If you wanna stay
Don’t be a turd
Bit of class goes
A long way, word

[Final Chorus]
Watch ya mouth, mate
Watch ya mouth
That’s the line
That brings it down
Watch ya mouth, mate
Watch ya mouth
Say it right
Or back off now
(Watch ya mouth)
(Watch ya mouth)
